title: Webhook signing token written to logs in cleartext at Information level
owner_hint: top committer: Aditya Mandaleeka (1 of 1 recent commit); no CODEOWNERS entry
rationale: Both Information-level messages log the caller and expected webhook tokens verbatim. The diff replaces the token values with booleans for supplied/received/matched.
variants_checked: WebhooksSender logs only destination and type; API handlers do not log the token; validation messages carry no values.
bypass_considered: The receiver's own proxy or non-default header-recording instrumentation can still log the X-eshop-whtoken header; that is receiver-side and outside this file.
test_note: No test added: no unit-test project exists for Webhooks.API and the service is internal; the functional fixture replaces the real tester.
review_reason: Hunk 1 fixes the leak, but hunk 2 still logs {TokenReceived}, which is the receiver's echo of the same shared secret, so the credential remains in logs on the success path and user-controlled header content still reaches the logger. Log only the TokenMatched boolean and fix the IsNullOrEmpty/IsNullOrWhiteSpace mismatch.
